messages.subject: [PATCH] fix compile error with LLVM
parts:
From: Andrew Hunter <a...@cs.washington.edu>

On OSX, `make test/math/seq_view` was broken; LLVM errors out on
unnecessary uses of typename inside an explicit instantiation.
These will become legal in C++11, but they're unnecessary in
either case, so let's just delete them.
---
src/stan/math/seq_view.hpp | 7 +++----
1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/stan/math/seq_view.hpp b/src/stan/math/seq_view.hpp
index 8e8ea09..7dbbc07 100644
--- a/src/stan/math/seq_view.hpp
+++ b/src/stan/math/seq_view.hpp
@@ -174,13 +174,12 @@ namespace stan {
template <>
class seq_view<double, std::vector<int> > {
private:
- typename store_type<std::vector<int> >::type x_;
+ store_type<std::vector<int> >::type x_;
public:
- seq_view(typename pass_type<std::vector<int> >::type x)
+ seq_view(pass_type<std::vector<int> >::type x)
: x_(x) {
}
- inline typename pass_type<double>::type
- operator[](int n) const {
+ inline pass_type<double>::type operator[](int n) const {
return x_[n];
}
int size() const {
--
